title: Truebit exploit exposes smart contract flaw behind $26M token mint
summary: Truebit lost $26 million after a smart contract overflow bug let an attacker mint tokens at near-zero cost, sending the TRU price down 99%.

title: Ukraine blocks Polymarket, classifies prediction markets as gambling
summary: The move adds Ukraine to a growing list of countries, including France, Germany, the UK, Italy, Poland, Thailand and Australia, where Polymarket is already restricted.

title: Nigeria ties crypto oversight to tax IDs under sweeping reform
summary: Nigeria’s tax overhaul pulls crypto exchanges into identity-based reporting, reshaping how digital assets are brought into the traditional economy.

title: Italy’s CONSOB puts ‘finfluencers’ on notice amid ESMA’s crypto risk warnings
summary: Italy’s securities regulator shared ESMA’s finfluencer factsheet, warning social media promoters that EU rules on investment recommendations and advertising apply to crypto.

title: Kraken-linked SPAC files for $250M IPO targeting crypto infrastructure
summary: The Kraken-backed SPAC aims to raise $250 million in an IPO, targeting companies building infrastructure and services for the digital asset ecosystem.

title: Solana Policy Institute urges SEC to exempt DeFi developers from exchange rules
summary: The Solana Policy Institute urged the SEC to distinguish non-custodial DeFi code from exchanges, warning that current rules could chill innovation.

title: Thailand targets ‘gray money’ with unified oversight of gold and crypto
summary: Thailand reportedly plans tighter reporting, Travel Rule enforcement and a national data hub to track illicit flows across both traditional and digital assets.

title: New Senate CLARITY Act draft allows activity-based stablecoin rewards
summary: A revised Senate CLARITY Act draft would allow activity-based stablecoin rewards tied to payments, wallets and staking, while barring interest paid solely for holding tokens.

title: VanEck says policy clarity could make Q1 a ‘risk-on’ quarter
summary: VanEck expects stronger risk appetite in Q1 on improved fiscal and monetary visibility, while warning that Bitcoin’s cycle signals remain mixed.

title: Bitwise CIO calls Bitcoin 401(k) restrictions ‘ridiculous’ as Warren presses SEC
summary: US President Donald Trump opened the door to cryptocurrencies in 401(k) retirement plans through an executive order issued in August.
